example.title: St. Mary's Catholic Church (St. Mary's Catholic Church Historic District)

brief: German-parish Gothic Revival church in red brick on a rock-faced limestone base: twin square towers at the front corners rising to open belfry stages with pointed louvered openings, clock/rose oculi and tall copper-green octagonal spires with crosses. The nave has a clerestory over lower aisles, lancet stained-glass windows with brick hood moulds and stone sills, and a steep dark roof. The two-storey brick hip-roofed rectory with a columned porch stands beside it.
